mostWorthwhile.text: Opening the wicket and bringing the shipment through made the earlier repairs and local control feel consequential; Eli's actual receipt completed the journey.

leastWorthwhile.text: The repeated intake attempts were frustrating: configuring the reader seemed like the missing prerequisite, but the supplies still needed to reach the door first.

surprise.text: The neighbor link attempt unexpectedly connected it to the verified water service, carrying readings across both blocks rather than checking requests.

arbitrary.text: The need to configure the intake reader before moving the supplies was not obvious to me, and the failed pairings gave little explanation of the sequencing.

continue.text: I would continue: seeing the shared passage and independent services used at dawn made the interconnected repairs feel meaningful, though I would hope for clearer feedback on prerequisites.
